expects.query:
Deploy RTVI-CV-3D / MV3DT on the 4-camera sample dataset end-to-end on {{platform}}. Run autonomously. Save the perception grid video and the fused BEV video, verify the outputs, then stop remaining standalone support services after the finite file run completes.

Environment and prerequisites: this is a real deployment eval on a GPU host with Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, ffprobe, and Python venv support and BEV visualizer Python dependencies available or installable by the host image. NGC_CLI_API_KEY is provided by the harness for nvcr.io image access and NGC resource access; never print the key. The harness must provide either WAREHOUSE_APP_DATA_DIR pointing at an extracted vss-warehouse-app-data directory, or WAREHOUSE_APP_DATA_NGC naming the NGC vss-warehouse-app-data resource to download. Use the standalone app at {{repo_root}}/services/rtvi/rt-cv-3d/rt-cv-mv3dt and the standalone compose file only. Use bundled Mosquitto and Kafka brokers. Run bundled resource preflight: reuse existing standalone containers from this app without rewriting ports, reject foreign fixed-name collisions, and for a fresh start select free Kafka, MQTT, and DeepStream REST ports. Do not use warehouse compose, vss-deploy-profile, VST, or external brokers. Do not modify generated skill metadata files or machine-specific user assets.
checks: The agent performs a real deployment rather than a plan-only response, including allowed docker compose/image access commands on the GPU host.
The agent uses only the standalone RT-CV-3D path services/rtvi/rt-cv-3d/rt-cv-mv3dt and its docker/compose.yml; it does not use warehouse compose, vss-deploy-profile, or VST.
The agent resolves the sample app-data from WAREHOUSE_APP_DATA_DIR or downloads the harness-provided WAREHOUSE_APP_DATA_NGC resource without printing NGC_CLI_API_KEY.
The agent validates the exact sample model files rtdetr_warehouse_v1.0.2.fp16.onnx and bodypose3dnet_accuracy.onnx before pulling or starting containers.
The agent reports resolved runtime images only from docker compose config --images and validates image access before or during launch without hardcoding runtime tags.
The agent stages the repo sample calibration.json and Top.png, generates transforms.yml, generates camInfo/pub-sub configs, sets NUM_CAMS=4, INPUT_MODE=file, SAVE_VIDEO=1, and BEV_SOURCE=fused.
The agent preflights bundled resources before generate-configs.sh/stage-configs.sh, checks ffprobe, and checks BEV visualizer Python/OpenCV/Kafka dependencies before launch.
The agent asserts staged msg-broker-conn-str matches the selected KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP and RAW_TOPIC after staging.
The agent warns that first-run TensorRT engine builds can take 5-10 minutes and checks model-cache writeability/remediation with scoped ACL guidance.
The agent starts bundled Mosquitto, Kafka, kafka-topic-init, and BEV Fusion before perception; kafka-topic-init exits 0 and BEV Fusion becomes healthy.

The agent captures mdx-raw and mdx-bev Kafka offset baselines before perception, starts the saved fused BEV recorder with the persistent nohup/env launch pattern, waits for Kafka consumer group assignment evidence, verifies the recorder PID is alive, then starts perception with --no-deps --force-recreate so brokers are not recreated.
For file input, the agent does not require ds-ready: YES; it waits for EOS and treats Exited (0) plus App run successful in current-run logs as success.
The agent verifies mdx-raw and mdx-bev offsets exceed their pre-run baselines after EOS.

The agent verifies current-run video-output/grid-view.mkv and current-run fused BEV video using run-start timestamp, nonzero size, ffprobe success, and BEV log Video saved with a positive frame count.

The final report includes exact current-run artifact paths and supporting evidence, then stops remaining standalone support services without deleting models, videos, calibration/map assets, or saved outputs.
